new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/fb/ok")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("Host", "front.example")
                ),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        10
)
.withId("fwf-ok")
.forwardWithFallback(
        HttpForwardWithFallback.forwardWithFallback()
                .withForward(
                        forward()
                                .withHost("localhost")
                                .withPort(<port>)
                                .withScheme(HttpForward.Scheme.HTTP)
                )
                .withFallback(
                        response()
                                .withStatusCode(203)
                                .withHeaders(
                                        new Header("X-Fallback", "yes")
                                )
                                .withBody("fallback for /fb/ok")
                )
);


new MockServerClient("localhost", <port>)
.when(
        request()
                .withPath("/fb/refused")
                .withHeaders(
                        new Header("Host", "front.example")
                ),
        Times.unlimited(),
        TimeToLive.unlimited(),
        10
)
.withId("fwf-refused")
.forwardWithFallback(
        HttpForwardWithFallback.forwardWithFallback()
                .withForward(
                        forward()
                                .withHost("localhost")
                                .withPort(<deadport>)
                                .withScheme(HttpForward.Scheme.HTTP)
                )
                .withFallback(
                        response()
                                .withStatusCode(203)
                                .withHeaders(
                                        new Header("X-Fallback", "yes")
                                )
                                .withBody("fallback for /fb/refused")
                )
);
